title: NgDoc modern development server builder
description: Angular development server with transactional NgDoc generation.

config.description: Workspace-relative or absolute NgDoc configuration file.

tags.description: Build tags matched against onlyForTags of pages and categories. Defaults to the build configuration name(s), e.g. production or development.

progress.description: Generation progress in the terminal. NGDOC_PROGRESS overrides it; the application option progress: false means summary. Defaults to auto.
